title: Sixteen Weeks and One Field
subtitle: 可持续发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 可持续发展（环境保护·可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：可持续发展（环境保护·可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：term　|　正文 292 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 term 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In the first term of senior one our school started a project called Green Campus. The head teacher explained the plan in plain language, avoiding the kind of ① term that only specialists use, such as carbon footprint or circular economy. She said that sustainability means handing the next generation at least what we ourselves were given.

Each class was given a plot of land and one school ② term — sixteen weeks — to improve it. Our class chose the field behind the dining hall, which was knee-deep in plastic bags. We also wrote a short agreement: four ③ terms, no more, signed by everybody. The first was that nobody criticised an idea without offering a better one.

So we dug, we planted beans, and we argued. For two weeks almost nothing grew. Our teacher told us not to judge the work in the ④ short term. 'Ask what it will be worth in five years,' she said. ⑤ In the long term, one field and one class do not change a city, but thirty classes might.

'Short-term pain, long-term gain,' she joked. I have slowly come to ⑥ terms with how slow such work is: this is soil, not a poster. Every afternoon we weighed the kitchen waste we had collected; ⑦ in terms of numbers, we saved about forty kilograms that month, and the dining hall agreed to send us its peelings free of charge.

By June the whole field was green. Our project was ⑧ termed the best in the school report, which surprised everyone, including us. Our head teacher's own ⑨ term of office ends next summer, so she has promised in writing that the field will stay. When the new ⑩ term opens in September, sixty students have already signed up to take care of it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. 术语；专门用语
D. n. 条款（常用复数 terms）
E. v. 把……称为；把……叫作（多用被动 be termed）
F. 固定搭配：in the long/short term 从长远／短期看
G. 固定搭配：in terms of 就……而言；在……方面
H. 固定搭配：come to terms with 接受；适应（不快的事实）

items.q: the kind of term that only specialists use
not to judge the work in the short term
In the long term, one field and one class
come to terms with how slow such work is
in terms of numbers, we saved
was termed the best in the school report
term of office ends next summer

answers.why: the kind of term that only specialists use，后接 carbon footprint、circular economy 这类专门说法，指“术语”。
one school term 后接破折号解释 sixteen weeks，明确是“一学期”。
four terms 与 agreement、signed by everybody 相呼应，是可数名词复数“条款”。
in the short term 是固定搭配，与下句 Ask what it will be worth in five years 构成对比。
in the long term 同样是固定搭配，意为“从长远看”，此处由 one class 推及 thirty classes。
come to terms with＋名词性成分，意为“接受／适应（令人不快的事实）”，这里指接受工作进展缓慢。
in terms of numbers 意为“就数字而言”，引出具体的四十公斤。
was termed the best 是被动语态，意为“被称为最好的”，term 作动词“称作”。
term of office 是固定组合，意为“任期”，后半句说她的任期明年夏天结束。
the new term opens in September 指新学年开学，“学期”，与第 2 题同义复现。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 这个项目开始于高一的第一学期。（term）
她尽量避免使用只有专家才懂的术语。（terms）
不要只从短期来评判这项工作。（in the short term）
从长远来看，一个班级改变不了一座城市。（in the long term）
就人数而言，六十名学生已经报了名。（in terms of）
我已逐渐接受了这项工作的缓慢。（come to terms with）
answers: The project began in the first term of senior one.
She tried to avoid terms that only specialists understand.
Do not judge the work only in the short term.
In the long term, one class cannot change a city.
In terms of numbers, sixty students have already signed up.
I have slowly come to terms with how slow the work is.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 term 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In the first term of senior one, our class was given a plot of land and sixteen weeks to improve it.
Our teacher avoided hard terms such as carbon footprint, and simply talked about soil, peelings and beans.
We signed an agreement with four terms, the first being that nobody criticised an idea without offering a better one.
In the short term the field looked worse than before, and we had to come to terms with that.
In terms of waste, we saved about forty kilograms of peelings that month.
In the long term one small field may not change our city, though our project was termed the best in the school report.
